paragraphs: An AI-native creative marketplace. Brands discover AI filmmakers, animators and designers by the tools they master and the workflows they can prove, write structured briefs with AI help, and run each engagement through to delivery.
Built for the byteXL x KampusIC hackathon challenge, "AI Content Creator Marketplace".
features: AI-native creator profiles: tools with proficiency, years and verification; skills, specializations, formats; commercial terms; and a portfolio where every piece can show how it was made (steps, tools, prompt example,…

Discover: search plus combined filters (specialization, tools, skills, content type, format, budget, availability, turnaround, verified only, commercial-safe tools). Facet counts, active-filter chips, five sorts,…

Structured briefs: deliverables (type, quantity, aspect ratio, duration, resolution), style and palette, skills and tools, full commercial-use terms (usage, platforms, territory, duration, exclusivity, ownership,…
AI Brief Builder: one rough line turns into a complete brief through Gemini, with a deterministic fallback so it always works.
Matching: ranked creators per brief, each with a 0–100 score and plain-language reasons (matched / missing / notes).
